_readme: On-Market page (Zillow listings in Allegheny County). Set with the user 2026-11-20. Underwriting (rehab, hard money, refi, targets, flip/BRRRR scores) is the Sheriff page's (reference/deal_model.json); on-market buy costs and the 90% offer are in deal_model.json on_market.

buy_box._note: Searched and kept: list price up to $200k, single-family or 2-4 unit multi-family, regular listings only (agent or owner listed: no auctions, foreclosures or new construction), active only (no pending/contingent/coming soon). Ideal (a filter tile, no score effect): 2-3 beds and up to 1,250 sqft.

arv._note: ARV = the team's own if entered, else the county ARV (scripts/county.py). High confidence: used as is. Low confidence: 85% of it is used and the listing is marked 'needs your ARV'. No county ARV: not scored.

score._note: Priority = BRRRR 45 + flip 35 + data confidence (up to 20), the Sheriff page's weights, at 90% of list. Plus: 'flips work here' +20 when 2+ flips of a similar house (beds within 1, size within 25%) resold in the same assessor neighborhood in the last 24 months; days on market +3 at 90 days, +6 at 120, +9 at 150, +12 at 180+. Capped at 100.

rent._note: Rent Zestimates are looked up by the Claude run (Zillow tool) only for listings that could work: flip profit at 90% of list above -$25k. Up to 150 a day.

alerts._note: Emailed by the GitHub workflow after each update: new listings, price drops and listings back on the market that reach the priority threshold (or pass $0-left BRRRR / $30k+ flip at 90% of list).

gone._note: A listing missing from a complete weekly sweep, or found in a recently-sold search, moves to Gone. Gone listings stay on the page 45 days and in the repo's state 120 days.
